title: Installment Step Controls
description: Manual step increment, total remaining commitment, and per-installment exclude toggle on the installments page
acceptance: ac-isc-1: each active installment card shows a +1 step button; tapping increments current_step and updates the card immediately
ac-isc-2: when current_step reaches total_installments after increment, the installment moves to the completed section
ac-isc-3: the summary card shows total remaining commitment (sum of remaining payments x amount for non-excluded active installments)
ac-isc-4: each installment card has an exclude toggle; when enabled the installment is excluded from the monthly total and total remaining commitment
ac-isc-5: excluded installments remain visible in the list with a visual indicator that they are excluded
